spans.s:
वै {c1c} P. (वायति)
1 To dry, be
dried.
--2 To be languid or weary,
be exhausted.

वै ind. A particle of affirmation
or certainty (indeed, truly,
forsooth), but it is generally used as
an expletive; आपो वै नरसूनवः

; 2. 231, 9. 49, 11. 78. &c.
It is also said to be a vocative
particle, and sometimes shows
entreaty or persuasion (अनुनय).
